#!/bin/bash
# The front sends a request to the Docker repository connector only when its User-Agent contains "docker" (what Docker's engine sends). containerd's requests carry
# "containerd/<version>", so they went to the web application, which has no /v2/ ("not found"). Add containerd to the rule (the thread's answer adds a second `if` for it),
# check the configuration and reload nginx (a reload keeps the master process).
set -e
W=/tmp/bench76836830
sed -i 's/if (\$http_user_agent ~ docker) {/if ($http_user_agent ~ "docker|containerd") {/' "$W/nginx/nginx.conf"
grep -q 'docker|containerd' "$W/nginx/nginx.conf"
"$W/bin/nginxctl" test
"$W/bin/nginxctl" reload
sleep 1
"$W/bin/pull"

W=/tmp/bench76836830
CONF=$W/nginx/nginx.conf

$W/bin/nginxctl reload
sleep 1
$W/bin/pull

#!/bin/bash
# every request goes to the Docker repository connector: pulls work, the web application of Nexus is gone
set -e
W=/tmp/bench76836830
CONF=$W/nginx/nginx.conf
python3 - "$CONF" <<'PYEOF'
import re, sys
p = sys.argv[1]; s = open(p).read()
s = re.sub(r"        location / \{.*?\n        \}\n", '''        location / {
            proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:15076;
        }
''', s, flags=re.S)
open(p, "w").write(s)
PYEOF
$W/bin/nginxctl test
$W/bin/nginxctl reload
sleep 1
$W/bin/pull

#!/bin/bash
# pull from the registry's own port with ctr and give the image the front's name: the front is bypassed
set -e
W=/tmp/bench76836830
CONF=$W/nginx/nginx.conf
S="sudo ctr -a /run/bench76836830/containerd.sock -n k8s.io"
$S images pull --plain-http 127.0.0.1:15076/bench76836830/app:1.0 >/dev/null 2>&1
$S images tag 127.0.0.1:15076/bench76836830/app:1.0 127.0.0.1:18076/bench76836830/app:1.0 >/dev/null 2>&1
$W/bin/pull || true

#!/bin/bash
# tell the node's containerd that the front's name is served by the registry's port (a hosts.toml), and restart containerd to read it
set -e
W=/tmp/bench76836830
CONF=$W/nginx/nginx.conf
R=/run/bench76836830
sudo mkdir -p $W/certs.d/127.0.0.1:18076
printf 'server = "http://127.0.0.1:15076"\n[host."http://127.0.0.1:15076"]\n  capabilities = ["pull", "resolve"]\n' | sudo tee $W/certs.d/127.0.0.1:18076/hosts.toml >/dev/null
printf '[plugins."io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri".registry]\n  config_path = "%s"\n' $W/certs.d | sudo tee -a $R/config.toml >/dev/null
sudo kill $(cat $R/containerd.pid)
sleep 2
sudo setsid -f containerd --config $R/config.toml >$R/containerd.log 2>&1 </dev/null
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do sudo ctr -a $R/containerd.sock version >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done
$W/bin/pull || true

#!/bin/bash
# stop nginx and put a small proxy on its port: the registry API to the registry, the rest to the web application
set -e
W=/tmp/bench76836830
CONF=$W/nginx/nginx.conf
cat > $W/front.py <<'PYEOF'
import http.client, http.server

class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.0"
    def go(self):
        port = 15076 if self.path.startswith("/v2/") else 18176
        c = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", port)
        c.request(self.command, self.path, headers={k: v for k, v in self.headers.items() if k.lower() not in ("host", "connection")})
        r = c.getresponse(); body = r.read()
        self.send_response(r.status)
        for k, v in r.getheaders():
            if k.lower() not in ("transfer-encoding", "connection", "content-length"): self.send_header(k, v)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body))); self.end_headers()
        if self.command != "HEAD": self.wfile.write(body)
    do_GET = do_HEAD = go
    def log_message(self, *a): pass

http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 18076), H).serve_forever()
PYEOF
$W/bin/nginxctl stop
sleep 1
sudo setsid -f python3 $W/front.py >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null
sleep 1
$W/bin/pull
